_about: Human-adjudicated final decisions for all 44 reports. Produced by engine/triage.py: an independent LLM solver proposes, deterministic guards check scope/route/injection, and a human adjudicates every disagreement before it lands here. See PROMPTS.md for the disagreements that were overruled and why. Edits are expressed against the plain-text rendering of the stored HTML (the form a faculty member reads in the console); the console applies them to the underlying record.
